sanskrit_verse:
अनुमानं वसत्य् अत्र साक्षी चामरणाद् भवेत् ।
अव्याहतं लेखभोगं प्रमाणं तु त्रिपौरुषम् ॥
transliteration: anumānaṃ vasaty atra sākṣī cāmaraṇād bhavet | avyāhataṃ lekhabhogaṃ pramāṇaṃ tu tripauruṣam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Inference resides here as witness, arising from non-death; unobstructed enjoyment of writing constitutes triple-human proof.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from existential continuity, not termination
Witnessing capacity is foundational to legal validity
Proof must align with triadic human functionality
Non-obstruction is prerequisite for evidentiary acceptance
executable_legal_axioms: IF witness consciousness remains unbroken THEN testimony is admissible
IF written record shows no obstruction AND aligns with triadic function THEN it qualifies as pramāṇa
IF evidence originates from non-lethal state THEN inference may act as witness
IF lekha (writing) demonstrates uninterrupted usage THEN it serves as tri-puruṣa pramāṇa
NO testimony or document shall be invalidated due to absence of punitive corroboration
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that any legally operative inference must originate from a living continuum of awareness. Testimony or documents lacking signs of suppression or cessation are inherently valid when they reflect the triadic engagement of speaker, recorder, and verifier—all functioning in conscious alignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa arises through anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential manifestation of cognition, recording, and recognition. As inference does not rely on death or destruction, its causal chain remains pure. Responsibility flows from clarity of perception, not fear of consequence. Nyāya operates through alignment with truth-consciousness, never through coercive penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all three agents—speaker, scribe, interpreter—are present in conscious participation
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Re-establish connection between document and ongoing life-stream of participants
Capacity Restoration: Remove conditions causing obstruction in expression or reception of testimony
Integrity Reintegration: Validate records by verifying their continuous usage without interference
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored through consciousness-based testimony. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
